title: Confirm the running folder and connection baseline
expected: Record the actual running app folder and build, open Accounts and Show devices, and establish whether the supplied ZIP is the working installation. Do not treat a connection on the other computer as a local pass.

title: Start the chosen copy; open Accounts, Module, Bench, and Ops
expected: Correct app is running; pages load with styles/scripts; no permanent Loading state.

title: Open the pages on the laptop and a phone on the same Wi-Fi
expected: Laptop uses localhost; phone uses the laptop address printed at startup; controls fit both screens.

title: Inspect Bench kit account, then Show devices
expected: Connected state agrees with account status; the device list loads; names and registration state are clear.

title: Register the intended module using Use as Bench kit
expected: Success message appears; subsequent list and restart retain Registered as bench-kit.

title: Run the normal allow step and restart
expected: The correct registered kit becomes eligible for control; the UI no longer presents it as unallowed.

title: Reopen Accounts after a successful login
expected: The sign-in form's intentional disabled state is explained; Show devices still works.

title: Disconnect, reconnect, and any emailed-code flow
expected: Test in simulator first or in a planned account-maintenance session. Account state updates, the result is clear, and reconnect instructions work. Do not repeatedly log out during control tests.

title: Wrong/missing input and failed sign-in
expected: Clear actionable message; no secret values echoed; the form recovers for another attempt. Use simulator fixtures for deliberate invalid-input cases.

title: Open device picker, choose kit, press Done, reopen
expected: Correct device loads; ownership is shown; Done releases it for the next session.

title: Switch among Paint, Module, Tests, Slots, Effects, Calibrate
expected: Each tab opens the matching panel and retains an understandable selected-tab state.

title: Tap one puck; drag across several; All / None / Invert
expected: Selection count and highlighted pucks agree; selection alone does not send a light command.

title: Toggle Wire order; inspect reported centre, desired ring, draft marker
expected: Legend matches what is displayed; numbers and wire route remain readable on phone and laptop.

title: Module → Power on, then Power off, then on
expected: UI reports each outcome and the physical module follows it; note latency separately.

title: Set brightness only at three values
expected: Supported brightness changes without unexpectedly changing the selected colour or mode.

title: Set white at supported low / middle / high temperature
expected: White mode and target temperature apply; any clamping to hardware limits is explained.

title: Set colour: red, green, blue, then one show colour
expected: UI and physical strand agree on the selected colour; compare reported state and visible result.

title: Every listed preset; speed at low / middle / high
expected: The selected preset runs; the supported speed changes visibly or any limitation is explained.

title: Every listed program
expected: Each offered program is accepted and shown. Empty capability lists disable the control clearly.

title: Choose bench-kit; inspect target status
expected: The page clearly identifies real or simulated execution. Job results identify the same target.

title: Gate A: read-only profile dump
expected: Results identify the device capabilities and frame/slot counts; JSON and profile download work. Record actual counts.

title: Index order
expected: The reported saved-pattern order can be compared with an intentionally recognisable pattern on the strand.

title: Gate B: select a slot
expected: Distinct reference patterns make the change observable; the job gives a verdict and collects the physical observation.

title: Gate C: replay a slot
expected: With distinct reference patterns, the BEFORE state changes to the copied pattern; readback and physical observation are both recorded. This job overwrites a destination slot: record its existing pattern first.

title: Answer questions and Apply flags
expected: Flags apply only when the run and physical answers support them; blocked application explains why. Verify the module page unlocks the appropriate feature.

title: Hue ramp
expected: The physical strand displays the index pattern; photo and JSON can be associated with this run.

title: Latency trials
expected: Trial options apply, progress updates, and recorded timings are distinguishable from physical response measured on video.

title: Whole-strand looks
expected: Each test look runs and each observation question corresponds to that look.

title: Stale-clock test
expected: Result distinguishes the old-timestamp write from its current-timestamp control where applicable; record physical observation.

title: Rewrite the showing slot
expected: Existing pattern is recorded first; job reports readback and asks whether the selected slot visibly updated without reselecting.

title: Rate ramp
expected: Run once after basic control is stable; progress and throttle/stop behavior agree with the job description. Keep the existing rate budget.

title: Unplugged Gate B and head-count-at-boot jobs
expected: Schedule as deliberate hardware tests after the ordinary UI pass. Follow the existing bench runbook, provide its confirmations, and restore the full physical kit afterward.

title: Restore
expected: Returns the test kit to the documented warm-white reference look and reports the outcome.

title: Stop this run, Recent runs, Refresh, JSON details/export
expected: Stop ends the job and releases ownership; completed results remain accessible; exports are usable.

title: Clock page: time, connection status, Full screen, PUT flash
expected: `/ops/bench/clock/` updates, fullscreen works or clearly reports browser restrictions, and a bench send can be matched to its timestamp.

title: Show-colour swatches; RGB only / RGB + warm white
expected: Brush preview and chosen recipe agree; choices are clearly distinguished.

title: Colour picker and colour brightness
expected: Draft responds to supported values without changing the real light until Apply.

title: White Off / Warm / Cool, temperature and white brightness
expected: Relevant controls appear; draft and applied output reflect the chosen colour/white combination.

title: Paint selected / Paint all
expected: Only the intended draft heads change; unselected heads retain their draft values where applicable.

title: Two-colour gradient: left→right and top→bottom
expected: Gradient follows the displayed spatial direction; selected-only behavior matches the page description.

title: All heads off / Undo changes
expected: Draft-off and draft-reset produce the expected preview; these are distinguished from immediate power commands.

title: Choose each available destination slot, then Apply
expected: The named slot is written and selected; no silent change to another slot. Record screen result, readback, and actual lights.

title: Apply with no meaningful change, during a pending command, or while Hold is on
expected: Button state and response prevent confusing duplicate operations; any refusal states what to do next.

title: Full white: 2700 / 3000 / 4000 K
expected: Each supported value applies; clamping is explained when needed.

title: Each show colour, whole-strand and painted, both recipes
expected: Chosen colour and route agree with the visible output; painted variants respect capability restrictions.

title: Recipe compare
expected: Left and right recipes appear in the described positions; centre divider remains dark as specified.

title: Thirds split, with distinct colours and brightness values
expected: The three spatial bands match the map and the independent values entered.

title: Hue ramp
expected: Colour sequence follows wire indices; use it to check the physical mapping.

title: Single head: first, middle, last, previous, next
expected: Only the intended physical head lights; boundary behavior is understandable.

title: Index sweep: start, pause, resume, stop, step interval
expected: The active index, actual lit head, and state agree; paused/stopped sweeps stop sending changes.

title: Lowcountry preview: each mode and canopy position
expected: The selected module slice or documented whole-module fallback appears. If unavailable, record the displayed reason and loading/log details.

title: Inspect each saved slot and preview
expected: Slot name, selected state, and preview match the readback; old data is distinguishable from new data.

title: Select each slot with distinct known content
expected: Correct stored pattern becomes visible; result reports its selected state.

title: Each slot action offered by this device: rewrite, read/copy JSON
expected: Action targets the named slot; writing requires the relevant capability; JSON can be copied.

title: Painted in the Hubspace app — record it; cancel and accept
expected: Only use on a pattern actually painted in Hubspace. Cancel changes nothing; accept records its provenance without sending a pattern write.

title: Inspect motion/brightness effect availability
expected: Only supported, enabled effect codes are selectable; unavailable effects explain what is missing.

title: Each enabled motion and brightness effect, plus static
expected: Selected slot and effect match the output; isolate one effect at a time first.

title: Motion speed, brightness speed, brightness depth
expected: Minimum/middle/maximum supported settings have the documented effect; labels agree with values sent.

title: Start and Restart
expected: Start applies the requested effect; Restart restarts the selected slot's animation. Disabled/refused cases explain their prerequisites.

title: Module Calibrate: orientation A/B, rows/columns, four start corners
expected: Preview mapping follows the selected physical arrangement; test variants in simulator first.

title: Save, reload, and reopen
expected: Mapping persists for the intended module. Restore the actual physical mapping after variant tests.

title: Flip wire order, then verify with sweep
expected: Wire order reverses as described, and the physical first/last heads agree with the saved mapping.

title: Calibration overview `/ops/calibrate/`
expected: Nine-module overview and links match canopy configuration; this venue overview is distinct from calibrating the single bench kit.

title: Hold dialog: name, Cancel, Start hold, Release hold
expected: Cancel leaves state alone; Hold displays the correct name and prevents changes from this module session; release restores controls.

title: Hold during sweep
expected: Sweep pauses and remains understandable; no unexplained change while holding a photo look.

title: Telemetry summary, Details, Copy anonymized JSON
expected: Result, timing, readback mismatch, and error describe the latest command; copied export belongs to the current session.

title: `/ops/`: status, nine modules, Needs attention, account summary
expected: Cards load, target/mode is understandable, updates arrive, and attention items agree with underlying state.

title: Pause/resume guest input; kiosk interaction
expected: Pause state is visible; guest actions are blocked appropriately; resume restores them.

title: Change each mode, Re-assert all, Safe look
expected: The simulated canopy and reported state follow the requested operation; progress/error feedback is clear.

title: Commission slots: cancel and confirm
expected: Cancellation leaves the scene alone; confirmation reports the commissioning outcome and respects the documented slot rules. Simulator first: this can overwrite saved patterns.

title: 7 am checklist; Run test mode change
expected: Checklist identifies actual missing prerequisites and results update.

title: Rate budget, logs expand/collapse, device refresh, alerts
expected: Data updates; controls do not leave stale panels; a failure has a readable diagnostic trail.

title: Navigation links and registry-overlay download
expected: Links reach their intended pages; the overlay downloads successfully. Keep deployment identifiers in local diagnostic records.

title: `/visualizer/`: Wire order, Index numbers, Desired/Reported/Both
expected: Each toggle visibly changes the appropriate layer and stays synchronized with simulated canopy state.

title: `/kiosk/`: every advertised mode tile
expected: Correct mode is selected; active state, progress, and any cooldown agree with the engine.

title: Repeated taps, paused input, temporary disconnection, recovery
expected: Clear busy/cooldown/resting state; recovery restores current state without stale queued selections.

title: `/vignette/entry/`, `/vignette/living/`, `/vignette/bedroom/`, `/vignette/garden/`
expected: Each configured room loads the correct devices, controls, scenes, and title. Missing devices/features have clear explanations.

title: Every control and scene offered in each room
expected: Repeat once per actual device/action/scene; sheet opens/closes correctly, values persist as expected, and feedback belongs to that device. Test simulated lock/fan/plug actions in simulator.

title: Create setup links for tester, kiosk, and vignette roles
expected: Appropriate options are shown; link creation/copy works; assigned scope matches the form.

title: Open each role in a separate browser profile
expected: Correct landing page and permitted controls are available. Do not use an ops-authenticated browser to prove restricted-role behavior.

title: Reuse/expire/revoke setup links and sessions
expected: User sees a clear explanation; revoked access does not continue to authorize new actions. Simulator first.

title: Laptop vs phone, narrow portrait vs landscape
expected: No inaccessible tabs, clipped dialogs, overlapping labels, or controls beyond the screen.

title: Keyboard Tab, Enter/Space, and dialog close/cancel
expected: Focus is visible and usable; action can be completed or cancelled without a mouse.

title: Refresh, back/forward, reopen a tab
expected: State reloads cleanly; old ownership and stale draft state do not silently send commands.

title: Open the same module on two clients; take over
expected: Ownership conflict is explained; only the active session can change the module.

title: Stop/restart the server during a simulator action
expected: UI reports loss of connection; after restart it reconnects/reloads or provides a clear recovery action.

title: Empty, invalid, boundary, and rapidly changed inputs
expected: Validation names the problem; no invisible failure or false success; final result matches the intended value.

title: Copy/download/fullscreen on laptop and phone
expected: The action succeeds or gives a clear browser-permission explanation; downloaded/copied results belong to this run. Record the browser and any fallback needed.
